summary: Completed comprehensive backend API testing for AEGIS Platform. All 32 tests passed with 100% success rate. Tested auth (register, login, /me, onboarding), marketplace (categories, services CRUD, search/filter/sort), service requests/orders, dashboard, Stripe payments (checkout + status), AI chat (OpenAI + Claude SSE streaming with real token deltas), and messaging (conversations + messages). All endpoints functioning correctly.
